basic_details.job_title: UP Moradabad Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 51 Posts

age_limit.details: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years. The age calculation will be done as of 01 July 2026. The date of birth recorded in the High School mark sheet and certificate shall be considered valid.

qualification.details: Applicants must be female citizens of India. | Only female candidates are eligible to apply. Applicants for rural areas must be residents of the same gram sabha, and applicants for urban areas must be residents of the same ward. The ward name must be mentioned in the residential address of the application form along with an attached residence proof certificate. For widowed applicants, a death certificate of the husband, family register copy, or a valid legal order issued by a court is required. For divorced or deserted applicants, a valid legal order issued by a court is required. Income certificates must be issued through the designated authority via the revenue department up/e-form/e-district portal under Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-राज0-9 dated 30.09.2011, and must be online verifiable. Residence and caste certificates must be issued with online digital signatures from the tehsil and must be online verifiable.

selection_process: The selection process for Anganwadi Worker posts is based entirely on merit as per departmental rules
with no written examination or interview conducted.
how_to_apply: Visit the official departmental portal at upanganwadibharti.in.
Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully before filling out the online application form.
Fill in the required personal, educational, and residential details accurately on the web form.
Upload self-attested, clean, and readable scanned copies of all required documents and certificates.
Verify all entered details and submit the online application form before the final deadline.
Take a printout of the submitted application form and the uploaded self-attested documents for future reference.
important_instructions: Only online applications submitted through the official website upanganwadibharti.in will be accepted; offline or hard copy applications sent via post or otherwise will not be considered. Applicants must exercise extreme caution while entering application numbers, registration numbers, certificate numbers, issuing dates, and marks, as verification is done automatically by the portal. Any incorrect entry or mismatch during portal verification will result in the automatic rejection of the application candidature, and the applicant shall bear full responsibility. Candidates must upload clean and readable self-attested copies of all documents; any submission of incorrect facts, fake data, or tampered academic documents will lead to disqualification. The number of vacancies is subject to increase or decrease as per departmental requirements and instructions. No written test or interview will be conducted; selection is carried out directly through the official online portal based on merit rules. Candidates must ensure they apply for the correct gram sabha (for rural areas) or ward (for urban areas) corresponding to their residential address.

content_sections.heading: UP Moradabad Anganwadi Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be female citizens of India. Only female candidates are eligible to apply. Applicants for rural areas must be residents of the same gram sabha, and applicants for urban areas must be residents of the same ward. The ward name must be mentioned in the residential address of the application form along with an attached residence proof certificate. For widowed applicants, a death certificate of the husband, family register copy, or a valid legal order issued by a court is required. For divorced or deserted applicants, a valid legal order issued by a court is required. Income certificates must be issued through the designated authority via the revenue department up/e-form/e-district portal under Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-राज0-9 dated 30.09.2011, and must be online verifiable. Residence and caste certificates must be issued with online digital signatures from the tehsil and must be online verifiable.

rows.qualification_required: Intermediate (Class 12th) or its equivalent qualification from a recognized board.

content_sections.heading: UP Moradabad Anganwadi Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years . The age calculation will be done as of 01 July 2026 . The date of birth recorded in the High School mark sheet and certificate shall be considered valid.

content_sections.text: The selection process for Anganwadi Worker posts is based entirely on merit as per departmental rules, with no written examination or interview conducted.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting UP Moradabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Office of the District Programme Officer (ICDS), Moradabad, under the Department of Women and Child Development, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in UP Moradabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 51 vacancies are available for Anganwadi Worker posts across various child development projects in Moradabad district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit online applications for Moradabad Anganwadi Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 28 October 2026 up to 12.00 midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for UP Moradabad Anganwadi Worker?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Intermediate (Class 12th) or equivalent qualification from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UP Moradabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age of applicants must be between 18 years and 35 years as of 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for UP Moradabad Anganwadi posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written exam or interview for selection?
faq.answer: No, there will be no written examination or interview; the selection process is carried out entirely through the online portal based on merit.

faq.question: Q8. Where can candidates apply online for UP Moradabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible female candidates can apply online through the official website at upanganwadibharti.in.
